statement: The University of Florida breeding programme and Florida Foundation Seed Producers publish different measured values for Optimus: the programme reports 241 g/mm firmness, 1.7 g berry weight, 15.8 mm diameter and 12.3 degrees Brix, while the licensing body reports 220 g/mm, 1.9 g, 16.5 mm and 11.3 degrees Brix. Neither source states the seasons or sites underlying its figures.
